correctness.rationale: For all a>0 and 0<b<=a and all points including interiors, reconstructed the three shortest-path candidate types and the max/middle of the three double-pair sums. Independently enumerated all nine unordered arm multisets, three closed ratio intervals, three possible maximal pair sums and all competitor affine terms, totalling 2685 rational parametric LPs. Independently solved each and reconstructed a nonnegative EXACT Fraction dual satisfying A^T lambda=e_w and lambda^T b<=0 in all 2685 cases (not merely floating objective values). Verified scaling and the three families of explicit quadruple lower witnesses: circle quarter points for b/a<=1/3; cross-long-arm u=(1-t)/2,v=(1+t)/2 for 1/3<=t<=1/2; u=1/4,v=3/4 for t>=1/2. Their pair-sum gaps agree at t=1/3,1/2. This is a finite exact certificate proving a continuous universal bound; finite random samples play no role.
residual_risks: The source compressed dual file is binary gzip and could not be decoded by the available GitHub text connector; independent exact-dual reconstruction verifies the theorem but does not attest to bytes of that compressed artifact. A shared error in the modeled candidate-distance equations remains a residual logical risk despite checking direct shortest paths.
